briefdescription.para: Concrete Ring wrapper around an owned FreeAlgebra (no quotient).

detaileddescription.para: Holds the wrapped algebra via std::unique_ptr<FreeAlgebra> and delegates every Ring operation to it. create() is the factory that builds the underlying FreeAlgebra from the user-visible names / degrees / weight vectors / heft vector and hands the resulting unique pointer in. The companion M2FreeAlgebraQuotient plays the same role for a FreeAlgebraQuotient.
